content.short: DEX aggregator and bridge that searches thousands of DEXes on 100+ chains for the best swap.
content.description: IceCreamSwap began as a DEX on Bitgert in 2022 and grew into a multichain aggregator. Its routing, powered by Nordstern Finance's index of thousands of DEXes, looks for the cheapest path for each trade. Its bridge includes a faucet that drops a little native gas on the destination chain, and liquidity providers can farm ICE tokens on top of fees.
content.meta: Swap at the best rate across 100+ chains with IceCreamSwap, whose bridge also drops gas on the chain you arrive on.
